card.name: Cavalo-marinho de Kaiser
card.summary: Pode valer por dois Tributos para Invocar por Tributo ou baixar um monstro de atributo LIGHT.

textEvidence.text: Kaiser Sea Horse may count as two Tributes for a Tribute Summon or Tribute Set of a LIGHT monster. Its controller can instead count it as one ordinary Tribute. This procedure does not start a Chain, target anything, or double the cost of another effect. A face-down copy can supply two Tributes; Skill Drain prevents this use of a face-up copy but does not negate the face-down one. Only one physical card goes to its owner’s Graveyard when supplying both Tributes.
